versions.changelog:
- Expanded documentation to include a "本地文件上传" section for handling local images by uploading them to obtain public URLs before processing.
- Clarified authentication and file format requirements for both image background removal and file upload.
- Improved and consolidated cross-platform (Windows, macOS/Linux) API call examples for better usability.
- Added step-by-step execution flow, emphasizing explicit user input for API keys and image paths.
- Removed redundant or duplicate content and updated security notices.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.

- Added detailed multi-platform (Windows/PowerShell, macOS/Linux) API call instructions, including encoding/temporary file handling for robust compatibility.
- Updated required parameter collection: agents must now prompt users for all required fields before execution and get explicit input/confirmation.
- Strengthened API usage notes, enforcing correct Content-Type and platform-specific invocation guides.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.

- No user-facing or functionality changes in this version.
- All files remain unchanged.

- 更新认证方式说明，新增了 Flyelep 控制台申请 API 密钥的网址链接（https://www.flyelep.cn/controlboard）
- 其余接口文档、用法说明和功能保持不变

- Initial release of the ai-image-matting skill.
- Enables automatic image background removal using the Flyelep AI API.
- Supports both single and batch processing of image URLs.
- Returns transparent-background image links after processing.
- Requires users to provide a valid secretKey in request headers.
